content.title: Energy & Utilities Roundup: Market Talk
content.summary: 1516 ET – Crude futures pick up from early losses and add to yesterday’s gains as the U.S. steps up actions in the Caribbean to cut off Venezuela’s oil trade and increase pressure on the country’s strongman Nicolás Maduro.  Tensions between the U.S. and Venezuela remain high, while Russia-Ukraine peace talks are going slowly, he adds.
